key.name: general-disable-on-battery
key.summary: Whether to disable shader effects on battery

key.name: preview-name
key.description: Set by the preferences to show the preview popup, the extension clears it again

key.name: wallpaper-enabled
key.summary: Whether to enable shader effects on wallpaper

key.name: wallpaper-effects
key.summary: List of effects that apply to wallpaper

key.name: wallpaper-animate-new
key.summary: Whether the effect reveals the new wallpaper
key.description: When off, the effect removes the old wallpaper instead

key.name: popup-enabled
key.summary: Whether to enable shader effects on popups

key.name: popup-effects
key.summary: List of effects that apply to popups

key.name: lockscreen-enabled
key.summary: Whether to enable shader effects on the lock screen

key.name: lockscreen-duration
key.summary: Duration of lock screen transition animation

key.name: lockscreen-effects
key.summary: List of effects that apply to the lock screen

key.name: lockscreen-animate-unlock
key.summary: Whether to play the effect when unlocking
key.description: When off, unlocking uses the default GNOME animation
